dishes.name: Butter Chicken
dishes.description: A world-renowned Indian curry featuring tender marinated chicken cooked in a smooth, creamy tomato and butter sauce. It is seasoned with aromatic spices like garam masala, cumin, and fenugreek leaves.

dishes.name: Biryani
dishes.description: An aromatic rice dish made with long-grain basmati rice, tender meat or vegetables, and infused with saffron and spices. It is slow-cooked in a sealed pot using the dum method.

dishes.description: A classic North Indian vegetarian staple consisting of fresh Indian cottage cheese cubes in a smooth, vibrant spinach puree cooked with garlic and mild spices.

dishes.name: Chole Bhature
dishes.description: A spicy chickpea curry (chole) paired with giant, fluffy fried leavened bread (bhature). A heart-warming breakfast and lunch favorite across North India.

dishes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
dishes.description: Roasted marinated chicken chunks in a rich, spiced tomato and cream gravy. Pairs wonderfully with freshly baked garlic naan bread.
